name: ODSOColumns
description: A collection of ODSOColumn objects that represent the data fields in a mail merge data source.
example:
Sub ShowFieldNames()
 Dim appOffice As OfficeDataSourceObject
 Dim intCount As Integer

 Set appOffice = Application.OfficeDataSourceObject
 appOffice.Open bstrConnect:="DRIVER=SQL Server;SERVER=ServerName;" & _
 "UID=user;PWD=;DATABASE=Northwind", bstrTable:="Employees"

 With appOffice.Columns
 For intCount = 1 To .Count
 MsgBox "Column Name: " & .Item(intCount).Name
 Next
 End With
End Sub

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Gets an Application object that represents the container application for the ODSOColumns object (you can use this property with an Automation object to return that object's container application). Read-only.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Gets a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the ODSOColumns object was created. Read-only.

properties.name: Count
properties.description: Gets a Long indicating the number of items in the ODSOColumns collection. Read-only.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Gets the Parent object for the ODSOColumns object. Read-only.

methods.name: Item
methods.description: Specifies an ODSOColumn object in the ODSOColumns collection.

parameters.name: varIndex
parameters.description: The index number of the item.
